May 27, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Fairpointe Capital Llc increased its stake in Gentex Corp (GNTX) by 1.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fairpointe Capital Llc bought 95,139 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.38% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6.17M shares of the o.e.m. company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $129.34M, up from 6.08M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fairpointe Capital Llc who had been investing in Gentex Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.43 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.18% or $0.28 during the last trading session, reaching $23.49. About 847,439 shares traded. Gentex Corporation (NASDAQ:GNTX) has risen 8.07% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.48% the S&P500.
